fields.label: Supplier
fields.description: GDL's fuel provider for this fill. Only BOD and STCBL are offered.

fields.label: HRS Liters
fields.description: The workbook's own column name. Holds litres supplied.

fields.label: Amount (BOD)
fields.description: Derived from Total Amount when the supplier is GDL's BOD provider. Kept because the claim, the book balance and every POL report are split by provider - it is simply no longer typed by hand.

fields.label: Amount (STCBL)
fields.description: Derived from Total Amount when the supplier is GDL's STCBL provider. Kept because the claim, the book balance and every POL report are split by provider - it is simply no longer typed by hand.

fields.label: Amount Overridden
fields.description: Set automatically when the stored amount differs from Litres x Rate.

fields.label: Recoupment (BOD)
fields.description: Not used in any calculation. Recoupment is held on the abstract as a whole - see Fuel and Book Balance.

fields.label: Recoupment (STCBL)
fields.description: Not used in any calculation. Recoupment is held on the abstract as a whole - see Fuel and Book Balance.

fields.description: Fuel drawn on this supply memo.

fields.label: Odometer Reading
fields.description: Odometer at the time of this fill.

fields.label: Driver
fields.description: Driver who drew the fuel. Defaults from the abstract.

fields.label: Amount
fields.description: Litres x Rate, calculated. An authorised user may override it; the approved figure is then preserved exactly as entered. Which provider it is claimed from follows the Supplier.
